purpose: Define the minimum viable quality standard for reviewed semantic icon records before approval.

approval_gates.label: Identity is complete
approval_gates.pass_rule: Identity clearly points to one icon and one source.

approval_gates.label: Visual depiction is grounded
approval_gates.pass_rule: The visual read matches what the icon actually shows and does not overclaim.

approval_gates.label: Purpose is specific and responsible
approval_gates.pass_rule: Purpose explains the recommended use, not just the object or source name.

approval_gates.label: Use guidance is decision-helpful
approval_gates.pass_rule: Use guidance helps a builder know when the icon is a good choice.

approval_gates.label: Avoid guidance prevents bad use
approval_gates.pass_rule: Avoid guidance clearly rules out nearby wrong interpretations.

approval_gates.label: Tags and synonyms support retrieval honestly
approval_gates.pass_rule: Tags and synonyms improve findability without inventing extra meaning.

approval_gates.label: Lane fit is confirmed or corrected
approval_gates.pass_rule: The review corrects seeded lane drift when the lane is too broad or wrong.

approval_gates.label: Routing score is honest
approval_gates.pass_rule: Routing score matches the real ambiguity level and evidence used.

approval_outcomes.label: Approve for import
approval_outcomes.rule: All gates pass, routing band is at least needs_review, and the record is publishable without rewrite.

approval_outcomes.label: Hold for editor review
approval_outcomes.rule: The record is close but still needs tightening in one or two places.

approval_outcomes.label: Keep as reviewed draft
approval_outcomes.rule: The review added value, but the icon remains too context-sensitive for approval.

approval_outcomes.label: Rewrite before reconsidering
approval_outcomes.rule: The current semantic frame is still too broad or misleading.

routing_policy.high: Use when the icon is visually clear, the purpose is specific, and confusion risk is low.
routing_policy.medium: Use when the icon is useful but still depends on product context or has bounded ambiguity.
routing_policy.low: Use when the recommendation is still too fragile for approval.
